title: Uniform Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions
summary: We prove a uniform interior $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ estimate for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3. For some $`\alpha_d\in(0,1/3]`$ depending only on the dimension, the gradient's supremum norm and α d -Hölder seminorm on B 1/2 are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on B 1 . The exponent is not explicit, and no endpoint or boundary regularity claim is made. In particular, infinity-harmonic functions are locally C 1 on every open subset of ℝ d , for d ≥ 3.

review.reason: Proves uniform interior C^{1,alpha} estimates for infinity-harmonic functions in dimension three and up.
